blessings.desc: The moon hangs low and generous; every harvest runs fuller.
blessings.name: Moondew Tide

blessings.desc: The spirits are feeling lavish with their rewards today.
blessings.name: Wishkeeper's Favor

blessings.desc: The grove soil is warm; pots yield more than they should.
blessings.name: Grove's Bounty

blessings.desc: The Dusk Moth flutters over the seed pouches, and prices flutter down.
blessings.name: Mothwing Discount

blessings.desc: A light rain of stardust feeds every leaf in the Haven.
blessings.name: Stardust Rain

blessings.desc: The Nightchoir sings your name between verses; wishes pay better.
blessings.name: Choir's Blessing

blessings.desc: Old roots stir and share their stored sweetness with the grove.
blessings.name: Deep Roots

blessings.desc: The Moss Keeper haggles the seed merchants down on your behalf.
blessings.name: Keeper's Patience

blessings.desc: The Ember Wisp burns a little brighter, and every harvest glows.
blessings.name: Ember's Warmth

blessings.desc: The blue hour stretches long; spirits trade eagerly in the long dusk.
blessings.name: Twilight Surge

blessings.desc: The wildwood sends a gift of rich soil through the root cellar.
blessings.name: Wildwood Gift

blessings.desc: A slow starfall dusts the Haven; moondew runs like a tide.
blessings.name: Starfall

blessings.desc: The longest night of the cycle; every wish carries extra weight.
blessings.name: The Long Night

blessings.desc: The Haven itself breathes with you; the whole grove overflows.
blessings.name: Haven's Heart
